text.p: Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Monday reshuffled his cabinet, with major changes at the finance, foreign, interior and defence ministries.
The announcement was made by Prime Minister Hamed Karoui after a meeting with Ben Ali.
Mohamed Jeri, who was minister for the presidency, is named as finance minister, replacing Nouri Zorgati.
Habib Ben Yahia is named as defence minister. He is replaced as foreign affairs minister by Abderrahim Zouari.
Mohamed Jegham has been appointed minister for the presidency. Mohamed Ben Rejeb who was agriculture minister takes his place as new interior minister.
